annotations.title: Local partner or acquisition candidates for a market entry (Legend tier)

description: Rank the LOCAL service providers of a target country or region — the firms a practice partners with, subcontracts to, or acquires to enter a market. `local_only` (default true) keeps firms with NO sister entity in another country (read from the brand-family key of the SSOT): a subsidiary of a global group is a competitor, not a partner. Filter by kind and by DECLARED SAP module; rows carry the declared modules, the sister countries of the brand (when any), the count of declared partnerships and the public directory fields. Ordered by SAP signal, then data completeness. `country` or `region` is required: a partner search without a target market is the whole directory. Paginated by cursor. Requires a subscriber API key, Legend tier or above. No person, no e-mail — outreach details stay behind the platform's signed-URL path.

country.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. DE, FR, CH.

cursor.description: Opaque token from a previous response's `_meta.next_cursor`. Pass it back with the SAME filter arguments; `null` means the last page. Changing a filter refuses the cursor.

kind.description: Restrict to one provider kind (placement agencies, ESN/SI practices, Big-4, SAP partners, platforms). Communities, schools and public bodies are never in this population.

local_only.description: true (default): only firms with no sister entity abroad. false: every provider of the market, groups included.

module.description: Restrict to firms with a DECLARED link to one SAP module code (UPPERCASE snake_case, e.g. DATASPHERE, BDC, SAC — call count_firms_by {by:"module"} for the live vocabulary). Absence means no declared link, never incapacity.

region.description: Region code of the HQ country — the platform's six-value geography: EMEA (Europe AND the Middle East), AMER (North America), LATAM, APAC, AFRICA (its own region, not folded into EMEA), GLOBAL (country unknown). Case-insensitive on input; anything else is refused.
